note: Trigger-routing suite. Positives are the moment right before a UI change would be reported done — the exact moment this skill must fire instead of a bare description-read. Negatives are near-misses owned by the abstract-property verify skills (focus-verify, i18n-verify, perf-verify, safety-verify), which reason about a property without a live artifact to drive, and by ui-audit, which sweeps a whole product rather than one change. Extended 2026-07-16 (n07): the ui-audit fence (Issue #8); /eval-run owed at the wave boundary.
